LCOM-SEISMIC.description: Load Combination for Seismic Design (LCOM-SEISMIC). A named seismic-design load combination whose members are listed in vCOMB; each member ties an analysis type (ANAL) and load case (LCNAME) to a scale FACTOR.

NO.description: Combination number (read-only). Assigned by the program; ignored on write.

NAME.description: Combination name. Must be unique when creating a new combination.

ACTIVE.description: Active state of the combination. Typical values: "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE".

bES.description: Elastic-stage flag; applied only for the concrete-design combination type (D_LCOMTYPE_CONCRETE) and has no effect on the SEISMIC endpoint.

bCB.description: Min/Max/All (envelope) combination flag (read-only). Derived by the program from the combination contents.

iTYPE.description: Summation (combination) method. Common codes: 0 = Add, 1 = Envelope, 3 = SRSS.

iSERV_TYPE.description: Eurocode service type code. Reserved/not applied by the current write path.

nLCOMTYPE.description: Eurocode load-combination type code. Reserved/not applied by the current write path.

nSEISTYPE.description: Eurocode seismic type code. Reserved/not applied by the current write path.

vCOMB.description: List of combination members. Each member contributes ANAL/LCNAME scaled by FACTOR.

ANAL.description: Analysis type of the referenced load case (case-insensitive). ST=Static, RS=Response Spectrum, TH=Time History, MV=Moving, SM=Settlement, CS=Construction Stage, CB=General Comb., others per solver.

LCNAME.description: Name of the load case being combined. Must reference an existing load case of the given ANAL type.

FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to this load case member.
